headline: GTA 6 countdown: 9 days to go
title: GTA 6 Countdown 9 Days Left | Jason + Lucia | Vice City Is Back
video_script: Only 9 days until GTA 6. You play as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a criminal duo inspired by Bonnie and Clyde. Grand Theft Auto 6 comes out on 19 November 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S. Are you playing it on day one? Comment below!
joke: Two heroes, one getaway car, and zero agreement on the radio station.
description: GTA 6 countdown - 9 days to go. You play as Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, a criminal duo inspired by Bonnie and Clyde. Grand Theft Auto VI launches on 19 November 2026 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Facts from Rockstar's announcements as summarised on Wikipedia.
